notes: two isnads meet at بكر بن صالح; the names «عن عبد الرحمن بن سالم ... عن أبي عبد الله» are written once: the shared tail
«وَالحَسَن بْنِ ظَرِيفٍ جَمِيعاً عَن بكر» is set as a co-transmitter of صالح; the text does not say that Sa'd's route passes through الحسن: a reading the page should check
the Imam Abu Ja'far (the Baqir) speaks inside the story («قالَ أَبي عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ لِجابِرِ»): last link (owner ruling 5); Jabir's testimony inside the story is a scene, not a link
«حَدَّثَنا أَبي» at the start is a relation
